Delhi High Court Appoints Seven New Judges

The Delhi High Court is set to welcome seven new judges who will be sworn in on Monday at 10 am on the high court premises. The new appointments will increase the court's total strength to 50 judges. The new judges include Nivedita Anil Sharma, Nisha Sahay Saxena, Sanjay Sharma, Bharat Parashar, Aditi Chaudhary, Dinesh Bhatt, and Arun Bhardwaj.
